summary: Describes a format for Message Disposition Notifications and Delivery Status Notifications that carry information about which media features a recipient supports. It lets a sender learn what the receiving system can handle.

eli5.summary: When a message arrives, the receiver can send a receipt that also says what kinds of pictures or pages it can handle, so the sender knows what to send next time.

questions: media features in dsn and mdn
how to report supported media features in email receipts
